# Johan Cilliers, SEO performance portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Johan Cilliers, an SEO consultant and software developer. It documents 19 client accounts where organic search grew year over year, measured in Google Search Console, plus the software built alongside the SEO work: MCP servers, dashboards, trading bots, and audit tools.

Site: https://www.johancilliers.com
Contact: johanlcilliers@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/JLcilliers

## SEO results (March to May 2026 vs the same quarter a year earlier)

- Healthy Start Florida: 2,794 to 47,442 quarterly clicks (+1,598%), average position 25.4 to 6.1
- Hillsborough County Tax Collector: 62,439 to 317,696 clicks (+409%), position 24.7 to 7.8
- Tampa Mattress: 6,497 to 28,554 clicks (+339%), position 15.9 to 5.1
- Continuum Wellness: 95 to 1,100 clicks (+1,058%), position 18.1 to 8.4
- Desert Dental Smiles: 250 to 771 clicks (+208%), position 39.0 to 9.5
- Dr Pav Khaira: 245 to 839 clicks (+242%), position 41.4 to 11.9
- Peddicord Family Dentistry: 633 to 1,381 clicks (+118%), position 25.8 to 10.1
- Acton Implants: 294 to 690 clicks (+135%), position 34.1 to 17.6
- Murphy Dental & Implant Center: 394 to 738 clicks (+87%), position 34.3 to 10.7
- Kayton Dentistry: 562 to 847 clicks (+51%), position 39.9 to 10.6
- Neal & Solevilla Law: 629 to 1,173 clicks (+86%), position 46.1 to 17.7
- XO Dental: 1,943 to 3,535 clicks (+82%), position 29.6 to 19.7
- Coastal CT Dentistry: 908 to 1,590 clicks (+75%), position 20.7 to 18.2
- Creative Smiles: 2,778 to 3,600 clicks (+30%), position 41.3 to 18.6
- Dental Aesthetica: 513 to 715 clicks (+39%), position 37.6 to 15.4
- Trapline Pest Solutions: 606 to 800 clicks (+32%), position 27.1 to 7.7
- Orange County Elections: new to search, 14,593 clicks, position 6.6
- Williams, Daily & Frazier Dental: new to search, 7,399 clicks, position 9.3
- Stages of Life Medical Institute: new to search, 1,332 clicks, position 14.3

## Software projects

- Google Hub MCP: one MCP gateway to every GA4 and Search Console account (130+ properties)
- MCP Connector Suite: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog and GBP as native Claude tools
- AI Trading Bots: gold, crypto, forex and equities engines with hard risk controls
- Search Insights Hub: automated client SEO reporting from GA4, GSC and PageSpeed
- Luminari: brand visibility tracking across AI search engines
- Answer Engine Optimizer: audits how LLMs describe a firm against its own brand truth
- Website Audit Tool: visual CRO and SEO audits as a branded PDF report
- Site Crawler: crawls a site and extracts its contact and tracking footprint
- Agency Operations Hub: one control panel for clients, MRR and agency operations
- Client Onboarding: token-linked client intake from request to signed brief
- statement2xlsx: bank statement PDFs into validated Excel workbooks
- LocumLink: marketplace matching locum doctors to facilities in South Africa
- License Control: Ed25519-signed activation-on-payment for shipped apps
- YouTube Transcriber: bulk video transcription with captions and ASR fallback
- RankWriter.AI: token-based AI content built for SEO and AI search
